main_text.p: uterque horum non folum probrofum ac fœdum institutum judicat, naturæ & rectæ rationi repugnans, sed & ab-surdam caufam,quam colorandæ fœdæ rei affert legislator, insigniter traducit: cujus summa hæc, ut neglecto cum fœ-minis concubitu, & libidine in mares versa multitudo sobolis,cui alendæ ager infulæ par esse non posset,avertetur.Ita πολυξενία[?] quam aliæ civitates bene constitutæ fortunatam atque utilem censuerunt, hic legislator velut infau-stam & noxiam damnavit, & è repu-blica suâ quasi proscripsit. Quæ quan-quàm sic habeant, tamen libuit Lycur-go hoc quoque institutum tam turpe in suas leges transscribere. Dê re ipsa suse disserit Plato libro viii de legibus, & absurditatem ejus pariter & fœdita-tem ponit ob oculos. Sed fuëre aliæ laudabiles ac præclaræ leges Creten-sium: in quarum numero illæ, quæ so-brietatem præcipiebant, compotatio-nes temulentas ac vinolentiam gravi-ter prohibebant: ad quas pertinebat Minois lex, cujus verba à Platone re-citantur, μὴ συμπίνειν ἀλλήλοις εἰς μέθυ[?]: tum ex, quæ rationem distri-buendæ annonæ quotannis, ex agro provenientis, ejusdemque confumendæ certam

page.notes: Greek words "πολυξενία" and "μέθυ" and the accents in "συμπίνειν" and "ἀλλήλοις" are uncertain at this scan resolution. The word "πολυξενία" is marked [?] as a reading, not a certain form. Printed spellings such as "probrofum", "colorandæ", "fuëre", "Dê" and "Creten-sium" are kept as they appear. The running head is in small capitals and is copied as "DESCRIPTIO".
